items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: This is the same time that Sally Rand was getting big at the World's Fair in Chicago.

ctx.x: And we were talking about that then. She used to come out there and sing all the time, man, you know with us at (Unintelligible) night after our last show, you know. And we stayed open to 4:00, and she got through down the Loop about 12:00 or 12:30. And they'd come out there and, boy, after the last show, after about 1:30 the last show, well, we'd just jam it out the rest of the night. She'd sing with us, man. She would really sing too.
I never forgot her. This is before she ever got big, you know. This is the same time that Sally Rand was getting big at the World's Fair in Chicago. At the same -- around the same period of time.
